test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

After having invested so much time and energy into the project, we are now __back to square one__.

options.text: Having to start all over again

solution:
The correct answer is: **Having to start all over again.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"back to square one"** means having to start all over again after a failure or setback. (फिर से शुरू करना)

 
 
• **Example:** After the software crashed, we were back to square one with our project.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**
